alertsDescription: Who receives platform alerts by email. Operators already see these in their notification inbox; this list reaches people who are not in the panel.
maxRecipients: Ten is the maximum — use a distribution group beyond that.
savedNoRecipients: Saved. With no recipients, alerts appear in the panel only.
readOnly: You have read-only access to settings.
backupsDescription: A backup runs every 4 hours (UTC) and is kept for 10 days. Manual backups are kept until you delete them from the bucket.
backupsOff: Database backups are off on this server.
backupNameInvalid: Enter a name of 1–60 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
